name: pod-identity-access-denied
why_hard: The service crash-loops with 'AccessDenied' on an S3 bucket right after a deploy, so the obvious cause is a bucket policy or a missing IAM permission. The IAM role has the permission and nothing about the bucket changed. The deploy renamed the ServiceAccount (billing-api-sa -> billing-api); the EKS Pod Identity association still points at the old name, so the pod runs with the node role, not the application role. The evidence is which role actually appears in the error, not the missing permission.
